items.source:
This method takes a text and trims it by removing a certain number of lines from
the top. If the provided text is null or contains only whitespace, it will be
returned as is. If the number of lines to remove exceeds the actual number of lines
in the text, the result will be an empty string.
items.translation: 该方法接收一个文本，并通过从顶部删除指定数量的行来对其进行修剪。如果提供的文本为 null 或仅包含空白字符，则原样返回该文本。如果要删除的行数超过文本中的实际行数，则结果为空字符串。

items.source:
The method identifies lines based on the system's line separator, making it
compatible with different platforms.
items.translation: 该方法根据系统的行分隔符来识别行，从而兼容不同的平台。

items.source:
A utility to reformat extracted text content before encapsulating it in a Document. This formatter provides the following functionalities:
  • Left alignment of text
  • Removal of specified lines from the beginning and end of content
  • Consolidation of consecutive blank lines
An instance of this formatter can be customized using the ExtractedTextFormatter.Builder nested class.
items.translation:
这是一个工具，用于在将提取的文本内容封装到Document之前对其进行格式化。该格式化工具提供以下功能：
  • 文本左对齐
  • 从内容的开头和结尾移除指定的行
  • 合并连续的空白行
可以使用嵌套类ExtractedTextFormatter.Builder自定义此格式化工具的实例。

items.source: The Builder class is a nested static class of ExtractedTextFormatter designed to facilitate the creation and customization of instances of ExtractedTextFormatter.
items.translation: `Builder` 类是 `ExtractedTextFormatter` 的一个嵌套静态内部类，旨在促进 `ExtractedTextFormatter` 实例的创建与定制。
